D.t: Nellie Pou leads by 22.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 70,033 votes; a one point swing is about 1,527 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +14.2 and D +31.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.8M cash against $40K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
